short: South Asian names in English prose
notes: Card: ' the' x6, ' V' x6, ',' x5, ' of' x3, ' Indian' x2, in Theosophical Society, Chitwan, Mahindra, Aurobindo contexts. The + pole is Indian state politics. Probe: 'ashram of' 0.87, 'in the Royal Chitwan' 0.43, Veluvolu 0.26, Mahindra 0.13; Western twins at most 0.04. Readings are uneven and often on function words before the name.
